surface_energy_definition.bulk_reference_policy: same model, dtype, device, and accepted Bulk Parent

execution_contract.registration_policy: A passed run is only a relaxation/convergence candidate; promotion to a maintained relaxed surface requires a separate hash-verified record.

energy_interpretation.warning: For an asymmetric or formally polar slab this is only the average excess energy of its two complementary surfaces, not either individual surface energy. Uncompensated polar pairs are diagnostic-only.
